moves.name: Stand LP
notes: Chains into stand LP / crouch LP / crouch LK
Incurs 20% damage scaling penalty if used as the first hit of a combo

punish.text: Nothing punishes (1f window), but you lose your turn.

moves.name: Stand MP
notes: Primary combo / frametrap tool with good amount of active frames for oki as well
+2 extra recovery frames (13F) on whiff

moves.name: Stand HP
notes: Fantastic combo / poke tool that's hit confirmable with a lot of active frames
Shoto stand HP privilege

punish.text: Nothing punishes (3f window), but you lose your turn.

moves.name: Stand LK
notes: Good range for a light normal
Incurs 20% damage scaling penalty if used as the first hit of a combo

punish.text: Jab-punishable — a 4f button gets a Punish Counter.

moves.name: Stand MK
notes: Forces stand on hit making this an important combo / whiff punish tool
Lots of active frames and good hitbox priority makes this a good button for counterpoking / buffering / oki
Deals more damage than most fully cancelable Medium buttons

punish.text: Nothing punishes (3f window), but you lose your turn.

moves.name: Stand HK
notes: First hit forces stand on hit making this an important combo / whiff punish tool
Second hit cannot hit crouch (-13 on block on if they crouch under the second hit)
Cannot be crouched under after blocking the first hit standing
Carries over Counter-Hit / Punish Counter bonus frame advantage to both hits
Great button for combos (despite the damage scaling it adds) and for whiff punishing and block pressure against standing opponents
Both hits put airborne opponents into a limited juggle state on hit
Situational anti-air despite its juggle properties, due to not having a great hurtbox for vertical approaches
+1 extra recovery frames (16F) on whiff

moves.name: Crouch LP
notes: Important tool for Akuma's combo routes as it leads into more combos than Akuma's other light buttons
Chains into stand LP / crouch LP / crouch LK
Incurs 20% damage scaling penalty if used as the first hit of a combo
Topmost hurtboxes on frames 1-5 are vulnerable only to airborne attacks (this is to discourage its use as an anti-air)

punish.text: Nothing punishes (1f window), but you lose your turn.

moves.name: Crouch MP
notes: Fantastic combo / poke / buffer / pressure tool that even combos into itself
Topmost hurtboxes on frames 1-8 are vulnerable only to airborne attacks (this is to discourage its use as an anti-air)
+2 extra recovery frames (16F) on whiff
When spaced out properly (1.53~1.57) away from the opponent, you can delay cancel (usually a 2F window timing) into LK Tatsu (QCB+LK) and follow-up into MK Tatsu (QCB+MK) for good damage and oki

punish.text: Nothing punishes (1f window), but you lose your turn.

moves.name: Crouch HP
notes: Head and arm are invincible to airborne strikes on frames 8-15 (during the active frames)
Good anti-air tool for vertical approaches but cannot hit cross-up (behind Akuma)
Forces stand on hit making this an important combo / whiff punish tool as well
Only cancelable on the first 3 active frames
Has +1 extra hitstun (28) on first 3 active frames

moves.name: Crouch LK
notes: Chains into stand LP / crouch LP / crouch LK
Incurs 20% damage scaling penalty if used as the first hit of a combo

punish.text: Nothing punishes (3f window), but you lose your turn.

moves.name: Crouch MK
notes: Standard shoto crouch MK but has quite a bit of hurtbox extensions before the active frames
Incurs a 20% damage scaling penalty if used as the first hit of a combo
The first 2 active frames are cancelable into Drive Impact only (guarantees that a counter-DI is possible when it connects with DI armor)

moves.name: Crouch HK
notes: Has very good range and hitbox priority
Has some Juggle potential naturally without Drive Rush
Has fixed framedata on block (always -12 on block even if blocked meaty) with +6F extra recovery frames (29F)

punish.text: Heavily punishable (12f) — full Punish Counter combo / super.

moves.name: Jump LP
notes: Quick air-to-air button
Can be used as an instant Overhead after opponent blocks a deep jump-in HP / HK / MK
Shifts Akuma's positioning / hurtboxes downards a little bit on frame 1

moves.name: Jump MP
notes: Primary air-to-air tool that puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state
Cancelable into Air Tatsu / Air Fireballs / Air Super Art 1
Has a very lenient cancel window (delaying the cancel is often better for combo conversions)

moves.name: Jump HP
notes: Strong horizontal jump-in hitbox priority
Spikes down airborne opponents on Counter-Hit or Punish Counter

moves.name: Jump LK
notes: Cross-up

moves.name: Jump MK
notes: Cross-up

moves.name: Jump HK
notes: Furthest horizontal range of Akuma's jump normals

moves.name: Tenmaku Blade Kick
notes: Can only be performed during a forward jump
Great tool to mix up your jump-in timings and bait early anti-airs from the opponent
Small hurtbox extensions compared to other Divekicks in the game
Can't hit cross-up (behind Akuma)
+6F extra (13F) landing recovery frames on whiff
Crouch size hurtboxes on frames 3-6 (3-12 on whiff) during landing recovery (but doesn't actually transition into a crouch state until the final recovery frame)

moves.name: Skull Splitter
notes: Great overhead with good start-up and frame advantage on hit, decent range, as well as hitting two times to blow through some armored moves
Combos into stand MK after Drive Rush f+MP, which forces stand for the follow-up combos (very useful for when the opponent didn't react to your Drive Rush Overhead and got hit while crouching)
Second hit is not an Overhead if the first hit connects

punish.text: Nothing punishes (3f window), but you lose your turn.

moves.name: Resso Snap Kick
notes: Fantastic poke tool with good range and hitbox priority, as well as good frame advantage on hit (can combo into 2HK or SA2 on Punish from decent range away)
+4F extra recovery frames (19F) on whiff

punish.text: Jab-punishable — a 4f button gets a Punish Counter.

moves.name: Kikoku
notes: Solid poke as well as a combo or punish starter tool
Can easily be hit confirmed into its target combo follow-up

punish.text: Nothing punishes (3f window), but you lose your turn.

moves.name: Rago High Kick
notes: The kicking leg is invincible to airborne strikes on frames 12-16 (during the active frames)
Not the most reliable anti-air despite the upper air invincibility during the active frames, due to hurtbox extensions that reach into the air before the invincibility kicks in
Launches the opponent into a limited juggle state
Fully cancelable launcher that's vital for a lot of Akuma's combo routes

punish.text: Heavily punishable (15f) — full Punish Counter combo / super.

moves.name: Viscera Piercer
notes: Primary combo tool
Counts as 2 hits of damage scaling when both hits land

moves.name: Bone Crusher Axe Kick
notes: Second hit (HK) is an Overhead
Puts airborne opponents into a limited OTG juggle state
Safe on block Overhead target combo that deals almost a whole drive bar of chip on block
4F gap on block (trades with 5F) but the follow-up HK can be delayed for up to 7F gap on block (trades with 8F)
Combos naturally but required Counter-Hit to combo on a delayed cancel, like when you want to hit confirm the follow-up Overhead
Counts as 2 hits of damage scaling when used in the middle of a combo

punish.text: Nothing punishes (3f window), but you lose your turn.

moves.name: Kikoku Combination 1
notes: Hit confirmable from the first f+HP
Puts the opponent into a limited juggle state on hit (can juggle afterwards in the corner)

punish.text: Heavily punishable (10f) — full Punish Counter combo / super.

moves.name: Kikoku Combination 2
notes: Hit confirmable target combo
Puts the opponent into a limited juggle state on hit
This full version is decent to use mid-screen where you don't get a juggle opportunity after the 2nd f+HP like in the corner

punish.text: Heavily punishable (13f) — full Punish Counter combo / super.
